notes.title: ⚙️ Engine Upgrade + Compatibility Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We’re excited to announce that Demonbyte has been successfully ported to the newest version of the engine we use! This wasn’t just a routine upgrade—it’s packed with long-requested features, bug fixes, performance enhancements, and improvements that many players (and fellow devs from other engine-built games) have been asking for.

While this patch doesn’t include new content, it lays the groundwork for a much smoother and more customizable experience moving forward. Here’s what’s changed:
[hr][/hr]🚀 Major Engine Features Now Live in Demonbyte
Instant Resolution Switching — No more needing to restart the game just to apply resolution changes. Change it, and it sticks immediately. 🎉

Mouse Invert Options (X/Y) — For the rare few who like their controls spicy, we now support full mouse X and Y inversion options.

Improved Mouse Movement — Mouse input is now much more consistent and uses raw input for smoother camera control.
[hr][/hr]🧱 General Fixes & Polishes
Company Splash Screen Fixed — A minor issue, but it bugged a few of you (and us), so we knocked it out while we were under the hood.

Menu GUI Text Color Changed — Swapped the harsh yellow text back to white for improved readability and accessibility.
[hr][/hr]🛠 Compatibility & Save Support
All saves made in previous versions should be fully compatible.

Broken/crashing saves should now load properly without crashing.
[hr][/hr]✨ Additional Engine Enhancements
Per-map light baking into vertex colors (for performance with dense lighting).

Expanded keybind support (some bindings now properly save and persist).
[hr][/hr]⚙️ Performance Improvements
Faster entity collision/movement

Better handling of weapon sprites

Optimized decals, particles, and skyboxes

Reduced FPS drops

Better performance for sequences and logic
[hr][/hr]🧯 Massive Bug Squash
This engine update comes with dozens of bug fixes, including:

Weapon flickering with multiple lights

Resolution scaling/rendering issues

Projectiles phasing through enemies

Crash fixes related to saving, loading, models, and particles

Fixes for improperly saved scripted light/weapon settings

Muzzleflash, draw/holster, and weapon state syncing

Transparent particle rendering problems

Dozens of crash scenarios now handled gracefully

For the full list of tech-side fixes (and there’s a lot), join our Discord!
[hr][/hr]💬 Final Notes from Could Care Less
This update wasn’t about new content—it was about setting the foundation. Future patches will now benefit from a more stable, powerful, and player-friendly engine.

As always, thanks for playing Demonbyte. Your support keeps the chaos flowing.

— The Could Care Less Dev Team

notes.title: 🔥 Demonbyte – Phase 1 Major Update: Foundations of Chaos 🔥
notes.notes:
Hey Slayers,

Phase 1 of our Demonbyte roadmap is here—and it’s a big one. We’ve been hard at work pushing new content, patching up bugs, and adding in a few chaotic surprises to keep things spicy. This marks a major step forward in our Early Access journey, and we’re excited to finally bring you the Foundations of Chaos update!

As promised, we’ve delivered 3+ new weapons in this phase. In fact, we added a fourth because... well, we could care less about limits when chaos is involved.

🆕 New Weapons Added:

Sword & Shield – Get defensive and bash demons up close.

Crossbow – Silent, deadly, and built for those who like precision.

Dinosaur Egg (Easter Egg Weapon) – Yes, you read that right. Find it, throw it, splat it!

DemonBeemGun – It hums, it beams, it melts. Enough said.

🌍 5 New Levels:

Phase 1 promised 5 levels, and we delivered—bringing the total count to 15 levels.

Level 11 is now fully finished (it used to cut off midway—no more!).

These levels are packed with traps, ambushes, and all the demon-slaying mayhem you've come to expect.

👹 New Boss: The Demonlord

It’s time to face a new nightmare. Prepare for a climactic fight with the Demonlord, our most chaotic boss yet.

🎬 New Cutscenes & Story Moments:

A brand-new story cutscene has been added to expand the lore.

Multiple mini-cutscenes added for immersion and narrative flavor.

4 new parody voiceovers to give you that signature Demonbyte humor.

🕵️ Secret Content:

A new parody Easter egg has been hidden inside one of the levels. If you know, you know. 😉
[hr][/hr]🛠️ Bug Fixes & Improvements
Fixed various wall glitches where players could get stuck.

Resolved issues with monsters phasing into walls (this may still require future polish).

Player no longer spawns facing the wall in Level 7. (You’re welcome.)
[hr][/hr]🎁 Surprise Reveal!
We’ve tucked a very special surprise into this update. It's not a weapon, it's not a spoof—it’s something much bigger and more meta than that. Play the game, explore a bit, and you might just stumble upon an announcement from Could Care Less that changes what’s coming next…
[hr][/hr]
Thanks for sticking with us through Early Access! We’re building Demonbyte with passion, chaos, and the help of our awesome community. This Phase 1 update lays down the foundation—but we’ve only just begun.

Stay tuned. Stay chaotic.
— The Could Care Less Team 🧨
